project_type: Next.js 15 App Router with TypeScript, Firebase Firestore backend
build_system: Next.js with Turbopack dev, npm scripts
verification_instructions:
1. Run 'npm run build' to ensure no TypeScript errors
2. Run 'npm run dev' and manually test each new page
3. Verify navigation links work correctly
4. Check that all pages display correct user data and computed statistics
snapshot_or_generated_files: No generated files to check in
environment_constraints: Requires Firebase configuration to be set up (already configured in firebase/admin.ts)
contribution_requirements: No specific AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns:
1. All pages are async Server Components under app/(root)/
2. Data fetching via server actions in lib/actions/
3. Styling uses existing CSS utility classes defined in globals.css
4. All text must use text-white class
5. Layout uses root-layout class
6. Firebase Firestore used for data with db from firebase/admin
directory_structure:
app/(root)/ - main authenticated pages
app/(auth)/ - authentication pages
components/ - reusable components
lib/actions/ - server actions
constants/ - constants and schemas
types/ - TypeScript definitions
public/ - static assets
